text:
maya: Heads-up — starting a curation pass to produce a multilingual HOLDOUT split for quant experiments + evals. Target: ~10k holdout balanced across 8 langs, parity across intent categories. Need agreement on sampling, near-duplicate policy, and how we lock the holdout from labeler edits.

thomas: sgtm. Do we want stratified k-folds for offline dev or a single frozen holdout?

maya: plan is a single frozen holdout (untouched by labelers) + a separate 5-fold cross-val set for model selection. Holdout must be exported with provenance metadata (source, crawl-id, timestamp).

jin: tagging on labeling side — we only have 2 annotators for ja/ko currently. We need to include labeler_id and annotation_round in the metadata and lock the instruction doc when holdout is finalized.

carla: near-duplicate approach proposal: use sentence-embedding fingerprinting, cluster by cosine similarity, drop duplicates where sim > 0.92 within same intent and same lang. Keep 1 per cluster prioritized by human-likeness score and token length.

maya: that threshold sounds reasonable. Any objections to the embedding model choice?

thomas: prefer a small, consistent model for fingerprints to keep compute cheap. Suggest `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` for now — reproducible and fast.

thomas: sampling config (draft):
```
{
  "total_holdout": 10000,
  "langs": ["en","es","fr","de","ja","ko","pt","ar"],
  "per_lang_min": 800,
  "intent_strata": ["qa","task","chit","code","rewrite"],
  "near_dup_threshold": 0.92,
  "fingerprint_model": "all-MiniLM-L6-v2",
  "kfold": 5
}
```

annotators: quick q — for low-resource langs are we oversampling from existing corpora or doing augmentation/back-translation? Also what's the label budget for rechecks?

maya: oversample to meet `per_lang_min` where needed; mark any augmented examples with `synth=true` in metadata. Label budget: 15k annotation tasks total for the pass, with a 2k golden set (locked) for QA checks.

jin: golden set — are we reusing the prior gold or building anew?

carla: reuse ~1k from the previous gold where categories overlap. Add ~1k new edge cases focused on long-context hallucination triggers, multi-turn state, and rare entities. New gold will be stratified across langs and intents.

dataset-stats-bot: holdout-draft created: 11,238 candidates before near-duplicate filtering. Preview: https://internal.redwood/datasets/holdout-draft-1793004412

ops-bot: note — running fingerprint job tonight on staging cluster (gpu-fp1). ETA 2h. Will upload cluster ids to the preview link when done.

maya: perfect. @annotators please pause any labeling against the candidate set until I post the final holdout and locked instruction doc. I'll post candidate counts after the dedup pass. :raising_hand:

thomas: once dedup is done we should snapshot the exact seed and seeds used for any augmentation so we can reproduce splits.

carla: agreed — add `random_seed` and `augmentation_seed` to metadata. Also add `dedup_cluster_id` and `cluster_size` for traceability.

maya: thanks all — I'll kick off the fingerprint + cluster reduction tonight and share the final CSV with metadata columns: exemplar_id, lang, intent, source, source_id, dedup_cluster_id, cluster_size, sim_score, seed, synth_flag, labeler_id (blank), golden_flag (true/false).

annotators: got it, will standby. :ok_hand:
